summary: Reviewed mcp-server/gui/api.ts and mcp-server/gui/server.ts (WP-011 modified files). 0 Critical, 0 High, 2 Low, 1 Info findings. Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: A01 / Defense-in-depth gap — gui/server.ts resolveRepoName(): The function accepts repoUrlParam and slugUrlParam without internally validating them against SAFE_SLUG_REGEX. It relies entirely on each call site to have run the regex check before invoking it. All current callers (lines ~524, ~573, ~600, ~630, ~645, ~660) do validate before calling, so there is no active path-traversal risk. Recommendation: add assertSafeSlug() calls at the top of resolveRepoName() as a defense-in-depth measure so the function is safe-by-default if reused.

A04 / Insecure Design — gui/api.ts resolveProjectStore() (~line 175): plan_path is read from .meta.json and passed directly to new LedgerStore(meta.plan_path, ledgerRoot) without a path-containment check. The ProjectMetaSchema (src/schema/project-meta.ts) validates plan_path only as z.string() — no traversal-safety constraint. A tampered .meta.json could supply a traversal plan_path. Risk is acceptable for a local developer tool (attacker would need filesystem write access to the storage directory already), but a resolve()-based containment check would provide defense-in-depth.

A09 / Security Logging — gui/api.ts resolveProjectStore() (~line 168-172): The catch block intentionally downgrades both NOT_FOUND and AMBIGUOUS errors from resolveProjectDir() to a generic NOT_FOUND ApiError. This is correct security behavior (prevents cross-namespace slug existence leakage), but the code has no comment explaining the intentional AMBIGUOUS downgrade. QA also flagged this. Recommendation: add an inline comment documenting the security rationale so future maintainers do not inadvertently restore the original error message.

A01 / Known Technical Debt (out-of-scope for WP-011) — gui/api.ts: handleListDialogues (~line 1335), handleGetDialogueFile (~line 1392), handleListChunks (~line 1465), handleGetChunkFile (~line 1527) accept a repoName parameter but still construct paths as join(ledgerRoot, slug, DIALOGUES_DIR/CHUNKS_DIR). No active path-traversal vulnerability (slug is validated via assertSafeSlug() before join), but will serve data from non-existent or stale non-namespaced paths once projects are fully migrated to namespaced storage. Confirmed by Developer and QA as a follow-up WP. No security block.
